title: Galax-z v10
description: Galax-z v9 plus what the Galax-z app needs to show the tumbler and EUCLID: the OP-Z tells it where the balls and the rings are.
notes: The Galax-z app shows the tumbler's balls and EUCLID's rings as they are, with their dials, on FX and on TRACK.
It is told only while the Galax-z app is connected. TE's app and everything else on the OP-Z are as in v9.
